gappers.catalyst: Amprius Technologies secured up to $75M DoW grant to retrofit a US EV battery line for military drone-cell production.
gappers.catalyst_detail: Amprius (NYSE: AMPX) announced 5:00am EDT today it was awarded a grant of up to $75M from the U.S. Department of War's Industrial Base Analysis and Sustainment (IBAS) program to retrofit an existing domestic EV battery line (run with a South Korean manufacturing partner) into high-energy-density cells for Group 1-3 unmanned aerial systems (drones). Line conversion targets 12M NDAA-compliant cells/year by early 2028; total project cost ~$100M including in-kind partner investment.
gappers.why: A federal defense grant validates Amprius' domestic manufacturing thesis and de-risks a major capacity buildout at near-zero incremental capital cost to the company, pulling in momentum/thematic buyers (US defense-manufacturing reshoring, drone/UAS demand) on a small-float name.
gappers.impact: Move looks driven by a real, dated catalyst rather than a pure headline spike, but a large chunk of the $75M is unfunded pending future appropriations and milestone acceptance per the company's own risk language, so durability depends on follow-through funding, not just the announcement. Premarket volume (~315K) is not exceptionally elevated for a small-cap catalyst print - watch for volume confirmation at the open before trusting the gap holds. No confirmed peer/sector read-through move seen in this scan.
gappers.horizon: LONG_TERM - catalyst is structural (multi-year DoW manufacturing contract, NDAA-compliance driver) rather than a one-day headline, and aligns with a defense-reshoring/industrials theme; worth a multi-day/week swing hold if it later clears the Confluence rule.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Zero open positions and 0/3 weekly trades used, so this displaces nothing today. At $10.655 with a 7-10% stop (~$9.61-$9.90), a 2:1 R:R target needs ~14-20% upside (~$12.15-$12.80) - plausible given the 9.96% gap already but unconfirmed without a session of price action; still needs to clear the Confluence rule (>=2 of VWAP/RSI/200-SMA/insider) before being trade-eligible.
